# proxmox_cluster_ceph_health_mute (Resource)

Mutes one Ceph health check through `PUT /cluster/ceph/health-mute/{code}`. Destroy re-enables the check (value `false`). PVE 9.2 returns 501 for this path.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_ceph_health_mute" "near_full" {
  code = "OSD_NEAR_FULL"
  ttl  = "1h"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String)

### Optional

- `sticky` (Boolean)
- `ttl` (String)
- `value` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
